settings.heading: We manage the program.
settings.desc: We handle the equipment, calibration, training and reporting. Your organisation keeps every decision that's legally and operationally yours to make.

settings.heading: What's included in a managed workplace alcohol and drug testing program?
settings.text: The scope is tailored to your organisation. It can include a review of your policy and procedures, nationally recognised collector training through HLTPAT010, appropriate testing technology and consumables, implementation support, documentation and ongoing program reviews.

settings.heading: Do you provide the testing devices?
settings.text: Yes. We can recommend and supply alcohol and drug testing devices, consumables, servicing and calibration, with connected reporting where needed. The exact mix depends on your policy, testing method, sites and operating conditions.

settings.heading: Can this cover multiple sites?
settings.text: Yes, multi-site consistency is a core part of the program. We define common roles, procedures, equipment controls and records, while accounting for each site, shift and jurisdiction.

settings.heading: Can I combine this with HLTPAT010 training?
settings.text: Yes. HLTPAT010 training can be part of your program for team members who need to collect specimens. We'll confirm training requirements, delivery and eligibility for your team before enrolment.

settings.heading: How is this different from just doing HLTPAT010 training?
settings.text: HLTPAT010 builds an individual's specimen-collection skills. A workplace alcohol and drug testing program connects that skill to your policy, testing method, equipment, documentation, escalation steps and records.
